name: chocolate oatmeal smoothie
instructions:
The rich half of a matched pair with [[spinach-apple-smoothie]] — same four-slot structure, opposite pole on each slot (dessert-adjacent sweetness, nut fat, flavored protein, grain fiber).

THREE REQUIRED SLOTS + OPTIONAL BANANA:
- PEANUT BUTTER (fat + creaminess) — 1-2 tbsp. Not greek yogurt.
- CHOCOLATE PROTEIN POWDER (protein) — 1 scoop. Not vanilla.
- ROLLED OATS (healthy fiber) — 1/4 to 1/2 cup. Not spinach.
- OPTIONAL: 1 BANANA (sweetness). NOT NEEDED for sweetness — peanut butter and chocolate protein already carry innate sweetness (see SWEETENER ASYMMETRY note). Add it if you want more body/creaminess or a more dessert-forward drink; skip it and the smoothie is still balanced.

Blend in a vitamix or high-power blender until smooth. Add a splash of milk or water if it's not moving — the oats + peanut butter make this thicker than the spinach-apple counterpart.
notes:
The rich/comfort pole of a two-smoothie pair. See [[spinach-apple-smoothie]] for the parallel build — same four slots, opposite ingredient in each.

=== PARALLEL STRUCTURE (COMPARE TO SPINACH APPLE) ===

| Slot | This (Chocolate Oatmeal) | [[spinach-apple-smoothie]] |
|---|---|---|
| Sweetener | banana (OPTIONAL — see below) | apple (required) |
| Fat + creaminess | peanut butter | greek yogurt |
| Protein powder | chocolate | vanilla |
| Healthy fiber | rolled oats | spinach |

The two smoothies are designed to sit in opposite registers — this one reads rich/dessert-adjacent/comfort, the spinach apple reads bright/fresh/green. Same purpose (protein + fiber + fat + sweetness in one drink), different flavor destinations.

=== SWEETENER ASYMMETRY — BANANA IS OPTIONAL HERE, APPLE IS REQUIRED THERE ===

The parallel structure between this smoothie and [[spinach-apple-smoothie]] is asymmetric on the sweetener slot, and it's worth understanding why:

- CHOCOLATE OATMEAL: peanut butter and chocolate protein powder both carry INNATE SWEETNESS on their own. The smoothie is already sweet enough with just those two + oats + milk/water. Banana is OPTIONAL — add it for extra body/creaminess or a more dessert-forward drink; skip it and the smoothie is still balanced (just less thick).
- SPINACH APPLE: greek yogurt and vanilla protein powder do NOT carry sweetness — greek yogurt is tangy, vanilla protein is neutral. Something has to fill the sweetener slot or the drink reads flat/tangy/green. Apple is required for that reason.

So the four-slot parallel isn't perfectly symmetric — the chocolate side's fat + protein slots are doing double duty (fat + sweetness) that the green side's fat + protein slots don't do. That's why the banana can go and the apple can't.

IF YOU DO ADD BANANA: it anchors the sweetness further AND contributes real body — one whole banana blended in gives the smoothie a creamier weight before the peanut butter does its thing. Pushes the drink further into dessert-adjacent territory. Apple in this slot would be wrong (drier and less sweet — different register).

=== PEANUT BUTTER OVER GREEK YOGURT — NUTTY FAT, NOT DAIRY FAT ===

Peanut butter plays the fat + body role that greek yogurt plays in the green smoothie. Different flavor register (roasty-nutty vs tangy-dairy) and different texture (thick paste vs thick cream). 1-2 tbsp is the range; more and it starts to coat the mouth heavily.

The peanut butter also pairs directly with the chocolate protein powder — chocolate + peanut butter is a well-established combination (dessert history: Reese's, PB cups, chocolate peanut butter shakes). The whole drink is basically a lightened dessert milkshake in protein-forward form.

=== CHOCOLATE PROTEIN OVER VANILLA ===

Chocolate carries the dessert register the whole build is going for. Vanilla would leave the drink underdefined — banana + peanut butter + oats + vanilla reads as a beige breakfast smoothie; adding chocolate gives it a distinct flavor identity.

=== ROLLED OATS OVER SPINACH — GRAIN FIBER, NOT LEAFY-GREEN FIBER ===

Oats are the healthy-fiber slot here — different mechanism from the spinach-apple counterpart (both hit fiber, but grain fiber vs leafy-green fiber). Oats also thicken the smoothie substantially as they hydrate during the blend, so start at 1/4 cup and go up to 1/2 cup depending on how thick you want it.

QUICK-COOK ROLLED OATS blend smoothest; steel-cut oats will leave grit unless soaked ahead of time. Instant oats work but tend to gum up. Rolled is the target.

=== NO AROMATIC SLOT — THE BUILD IS ALREADY CARRYING ITSELF ===

Unlike the spinach-apple counterpart (which needs ginger or cilantro to keep it from reading one-note-sweet), this smoothie's flavor architecture — chocolate + peanut butter + banana + oats — is already doing plenty. Adding an aromatic (cinnamon, vanilla extract) is fine but not necessary. Cinnamon is the most obvious optional add-in if you want one.

=== SIBLING RECIPE ===

- [[spinach-apple-smoothie]]: the fresh/green pole. Same four-slot structure, opposite ingredient in every slot.
